messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long‑weekend holidays that occurred in Canada in 2023**.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a Monday, Friday, or a day that, together with the adjacent weekend, gives you a three‑day break.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Provinces/territories that observe it | Long‑weekend span |
|-------------|---------|---------------------------------------|-------------------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day | AB, SK, ON, NB, MB, PE, NL, NT, YT | Feb 18–20 |
| **Mar 17** | St. Patrick’s Day | ON (new statutory holiday in 2023) | Mar 17–19 |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | All provinces & territories | Apr 7–9 |
| **Apr 23** | St. George’s Day | BC (new statutory holiday in 2023) | Apr 23–25 |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | All provinces & territories | May 20–22 |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | All provinces & territories | Sep 2–4 |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | All provinces & territories | Oct 7–9 |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day | All provinces & territories | Nov 9–11 |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | All provinces & territories | Dec 23–25 |

### Notes

* **New Year’s Day (Jan 1)** and **Canada Day (Jul 1)** both fell on a Saturday in 2023, so they did not create a long weekend.  
* **Boxing Day (Dec 26)** fell on a Tuesday, so it did not add to a long weekend.  
* Some provinces have additional holidays that create long weekends (e.g., **St. Patrick’s Day** in Ontario and **St. George’s Day** in British Columbia, both introduced in 2023).  
* If you’re planning trips for a specific province, double‑check that province’s holiday calendar—some holidays (like Family Day) are not observed everywhere.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app!
